text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both Yamanin Zephyr and Tokai Teio 
suffered defeat...! Though bitter,
the two 
found joy in how formidable the wall of 
the Arima Kinen truly was.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even giving it our all wasn't enough—
Yet, 
if we continue to challenge such immense 
hardships, we are bound to reach even 
greater heights eventually.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two promised never to give up,
to keep 
running together, and to one day reach 
their ideal.
